t: Of the funds available under this heading in Public Law 103–332 and any unobligated balances from funds appropriated under this heading in prior years, $20,890,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: This provision only rescinds previously appropriated funds. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue for any party outside the federal government. There is no real tempting contrary reading, since the text is purely a budgetary action internal to the federal government.
